description:
An open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, powered by OpenCode

OpenWork is an extensible, open-source “Claude Work” style system for knowledge workers.
It’s a native desktop app that runs OpenCode under the hood, but presents it as a clean, guided workflow:
- pick a workspace
- start a run
- watch progress + plan updates
- approve permissions when needed
- reuse what works (templates + skills)
The goal: make “agentic work” feel like a product, not a terminal.
MCP Apps become easier to set up and safer to use
- MCP Apps now show external setup links, can use bound resources, and appear in a more compact dashboard layout.
- Live apps now have a read-only execution boundary, while gated actions use clearer in-app approval.
- Fixed app discovery, actions, errors, and refresh behavior so interactive apps stay available and dependable.
- Sessions preserve workbench continuity and message order more reliably during navigation and streaming.
- Improved browser previews, OAuth refreshes, model settings, and cloud runtime behavior.
Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · Compare
Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.
